subject: science
chapter_title: Earth as a System: Energy, Matter, and Life

concepts.title: Earth as a Connected System
concepts.definition: Earth works as one connected system: the warming of Arabian Sea water affects the southwest monsoon, land, water, air and life exchange energy and matter continuously, so a change in one sphere ripples through all the others.
concepts.key_idea: One planet, many spheres, one system: every part talks to every other.
concepts.textbook_ref: iesc113.txt opening sections (earth as a system, monsoon example)
question_patterns: how does the warming of Arabian Sea water affect the monsoon
explain why earth is called a system
name the spheres of the earth system and their interactions
give an example of matter moving between two spheres
how does energy from the sun drive the earth system
trace one change through the land-water-air-life chain

solution_steps.explain: Lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere and biosphere make the system.
Energy flows in from the sun while matter cycles within.
One sphere's change - sea warming - reshapes weather and life.

concepts.title: Cycles of Matter: Water, Carbon and Nutrients
concepts.definition: Matter on earth moves in closed loops: water evaporates, condenses and rains back; carbon travels between air, living beings and fuels; and nutrients recycle through soil, plants and animals, keeping the materials of life in endless circulation.
concepts.key_idea: Nothing is thrown away on earth - matter cycles, life borrows.
question_patterns: describe the water cycle with its main stages
how does carbon cycle between the atmosphere and living beings
why are nutrient cycles important for life
draw and explain the given cycle from the chapter
what role do decomposers play in matter cycles
how do human activities disturb these cycles

solution_steps.explain: Pick water, carbon or nitrogen and trace its journey.
Air, oceans, soil and organisms act as stores.
Processes like evaporation, photosynthesis and decay return the substance.

concepts.title: Energy Flow and Life Support
concepts.definition: Energy enters the earth system almost entirely from the sun, flows one way through food chains, and finally leaves as heat; this one-way flow plus the recycling of matter together support the biosphere - and human pressures now strain this support system.
concepts.key_idea: Sun in, heat out, matter recycled: the energy ledger that runs life.
concepts.textbook_ref: iesc113.txt sections on energy flow and the biosphere
question_patterns: how does energy from the sun flow through living systems
why can energy not be recycled like matter - explain
what is the biosphere and why is it fragile
trace the energy flow from sun to top consumer
how do human activities strain the earth system
suggest steps to keep the earth system healthy

solution_steps.explain: Photosynthesis captures sunlight into chemical energy.
Energy passes through food chains and exits as heat.
Pollution and warming disturb the flows that sustain life.
